title: FRET-Seq: a High-Throughput FRET-Based Screening Platform to Improve FRET Biosensors in Mammalian Cells
protocol: Amplify gene fragments including ECFP, LacZ, YPet, EV linker, and a kinase domain by PCR using Q5 DNA polymerase.
Ligate each gene fragment into the pSin lentiviral transfer vector between SpeI and EcoRI with T4 ligase.
Transform the ligation product to DH5α with the mixture of IPTG and X-Gal.
Seed cells onto the LB agar plate with ampicillin at 37°C overnight.
Select only blue colonies for plasmid purification.
Verify the sequence of pSin-ELYK by Sanger sequencing before use.
Replace the “K” domain in pSin-ELYK with the gene fragment of either active or dead Fyn kinase domain using T4 ligase.
Replace the “LacZ” domain in pSin-ELYK with the Fyn-specific sensing domain using Golden Gate DNA assembly.
Transform the DNA assembly product to DH5α with a mixture of IPTG and X-Gal, then seed cells onto an LB agar plate with ampicillin at 37°C overnight.
Select only white colonies for plasmid purification.
Verify the sequence of the Fyn saFRET biosensor by Sanger sequencing before use.
Transfect purified plasmids of Fyn saFRET biosensors to HEK293T cells using Lipofectamin3000.
After 36-48 hours of transfection, harvest and lyse cells with lysis buffer.
Centrifuge the cell suspension and collect supernatants.
Mix the supernatants with SDS-PAGE protein loading buffer, boil, and load into an SDS-PAGE gel.
Conduct a western blot using Anti-GFP antibody to target the biosensor and Anti-Phosphotyrosine antibody to target phosphotyrosine.
Capture the gel image by gel documentation.
Transfect purified plasmids of Fyn saFRET biosensors to HEK293T cells using Lipofectamin3000.
Seed transfected cells on a fibronectin-coated glass-bottom dish after 36-48 h of transfection.
Culture the seeded cells in 0.5% FBS DMEM medium for 12 h before inhibitor stimulation.
Stimulate the cells with 10 µg/mL of PP1 for Fyn kinase.
Image the activity of the biosensor in response to PP1 as detailed in "Microscopy, Image Acquisition, and quantification".
Use a pair of primers to generate the substrate libraries by PCR with Q5 DNA polymerase.
Vary the annealing temperature from 55-70°C and set the thermocycling condition at 20 cycles.
Load PCR products of four substrate libraries in a 1.5% agarose gel.
Excise gels with the correct size and purify them using Zymoclean gel DNA recovery kit.
Replace the LacZ domain of the pSin-ELYK template between Esp3I restriction sites with purified DNA fragments from the sensing domain containing substrate libraries using Golden Gate assembly.
Purify and concentrate assembly products using DNA Clean and Concentrator Kits.
Add purified assembly products (volume < 2.5 μL) to 25 μL DH10B cells, then add the mixture into a 0.1 cm cuvette for electroporation.
Recover electroporated cells in warm SOC medium at 37°C for 1 hour.
Transfer cells to 250 mL LB medium with ampicillin and culture at 37°C for 12 hours.
Collect cells from the cell culture and extract plasmids using Qiagen HiSpeed Plasmid Maxi kit.
Store purified plasmids in 1 mL nuclease-free water at -20°C.
Verify the plasmids containing substrate libraries by Sanger sequencing, western blotting, and imaging before use.
Seed 5⨯10^6 Lenti-X 293T cells in a 100-mm cell culture dish with 10% FBS DMEM medium.
Replace the medium with fresh medium 3-6 hours before transfection.
Use the ProFection® mammalian transfection system for transfection according to the protocol provided.
After 6 hours of transfection, replace the medium with fresh medium.
Collect the medium containing virus particles after 48 hours of transfection.
Filter collected virus particles through a 0.45µm filter.
Concentrate filtered virus particles using PEG-it virus precipitation solution overnight at 4°C.
Centrifuge the virus precipitation solution to collect the virus pellet.
Dissolve the virus pellet with PBS and store it at -20°C.
Measure viral titer by flow cytometry before use.
Seed 2⨯10^6 HEK293T cells in a 100-mm cell culture dish with 10% FBS DMEM medium.
Replace the medium with fresh medium 6 hours before transduction.
Add the concentrated virus with a multiplicity of infection (MOI) of 0.1 to HEK293T cell culture.
Incubate cells for 36-48 hours.
Pass cells to a new cell culture dish when the cell density reaches about 90% confluence.
Test cells for transduction efficiency using flow cytometry.
Add puromycin to the cell culture medium to allow only library-transduced cells to grow.
Prepare several control groups of transfected/transduced HEK293T cells 1-2 weeks before sorting.
Collect seven groups of cells in #1.
Resuspend collected cells in PBS with 5% BSA.
Use resuspended cells to create gating profiles for cell sorting in the BD FACS Aria II Cell Sorter.
Set excitation wavelength at 405 nm for ECFP.
Collect cells from each group as the "input library" for high-throughput sequencing before sorting.
Sort Lib1 with different kinase activity (KA or KD) by FACS into two groups based on individual FRET ratio.
Extract total RNAs of each non-sorted and sorted cell using RNeasy Mini Kit.
Incubate the column with RQ1 RNase-Free DNase to remove genomic DNA.
Purify RNA from each group.
Quantify purified RNA.
Check RNA quality by gel electrophoresis.
Use purified total RNA (~500 ng) as a template for cDNA synthesis using SuperScript IV reverse transcriptase with a gene-specific primer.
Add adaptor sequences with different indexes for Illumina sequencing into cDNA by PCR using Q5 DNA polymerase with low PCR cycles (< 16 cycles).
Load the individual amplicon library with specific index to a 2% agarose gel.
Excise the gels containing the correct size of the library and purify them using Zymoclean gel DNA recovery kit.
Verify the DNA sequence of purified amplicon libraries by Sanger sequencing.
Quantify purified amplicon libraries by Qubit prior to sequencing by Illumina HiSeq4000 with 50-bp single-end sequencing.
Separate FASTQ files from Illumina HiSeq4000 containing the sequence data of the substrate from each library by indexes.
Check their sequencing qualities using FastQC.
Extract only sequence data of the substrate domain with a Phred score > 20 at all positions covering the constant region of the substrate sequence.
Construct the biosensor by replacing the wild-type sensing domain substrate sequence with a predicted substrate sequence using PCR.
Anneal the forward primer to the 5’-end of the sensing domain (SH2 domain).
Design the reverse primer containing the predicted substrate sequence and anneal it to the 3’-end of the sensing domain.
Replace the LacZ of pSin-ELYK plasmid with the sensing domain carrying the new substrate sequence using Golden Gate assembly.
Transform, purify, and sequence the assembly product by Sanger sequencing before use.
Transfect the purified biosensor plasmid into HEK293T cells using Lipofectamine 3000.
Seed transfected cells on fibronectin-coated glass-bottom dishes and culture in 0.5% FBS DMEM for 12 hours.
Stimulate the cells with PP1 (10 µg/mL) for Fyn after culturing.
Wash out PP1 by replacing the medium containing PP1 with normal medium after washing three times.
Take images with a Nikon Eclipse Ti inverted microscope using a cooled charge-coupled device (CCD) camera.
Use a 420DF20 excitation filter, a 450DRLP dichroic mirror, and two emission filters controlled by a filter changer for imaging.
Acquire time-lapse fluorescence images with MetaMorph 7.8 software.
Capture endpoint fluorescence images using MetaFluor 7.8 (Molecular Devices).
Calculate the ECFP/FRET ratio images using Fluocell software.
Visualize the calculated ECFP/FRET ratio images with the intensity modified display (IMD) method by Fluocell software.
Show normalized values for data presentation to compare differences among experimental groups and minimize cell-cell heterogeneity.
Establish a pre-stimulation baseline for each cell by averaging the FRET ratio of each cell before stimulation.
